purpose: Machine-readable availability/limitation record for a second paired-sensor corpus.

existing_paired_corpus.name: TAPS Throat and Acoustic Paired Speech Dataset
existing_paired_corpus.role: existing paired corpus used for Builds 13-15 and validation cross-validation
existing_paired_corpus.local_processing_status: validated through validation/run_taps_cv.py with an external root path
existing_paired_corpus.notes: The corpus is not redistributed. Its derived tables, scripts, logs and findings are under theory_development/empirical_results/taps/.

second_paired_corpus.reason_not_added: No second paired-sensor corpus is present in this repository, and no licensed redistributable download was performed for this commit.
second_paired_corpus.blocked_by: external corpus availability and license terms
required_before_use: A paired-sensor corpus with simultaneous throat/acoustic or equivalent paired channels
Speaker and sentence grouping available in memory for cross-validation
License terms that permit local research processing and aggregate reporting
A documented split and provenance record
No transcripts, raw speaker IDs or demographics written to outputs

minimum_evaluation_protocol.statistics: within-speaker RDM Spearman correlations, shuffled-pair nulls, speaker bootstrap intervals
minimum_evaluation_protocol.privacy: aggregate outputs only; raw IDs and transcripts never exported

adapter_notes: Current Builds 13-15 expect throat_microphone.wav and acoustic_microphone.wav pairs plus features.json metadata.
A second corpus with different filenames or metadata needs a small adapter that emits the same pair structure in memory.
The seeded validation wrapper binds the explicit salt before analysis and writes seeded_salt_provenance.json.

execution_path.frozen_direct_cli: historical reproduction only; direct frozen runs may still use ephemeral salts
